components.name: Cliff-embedded wall
components.function: Need cliff-embedded wall/round-tower hosts, moon-screen support/reveal, terrace/stair cutback and ghat/water-outlet junctions. Existing turquoise scale tiles, banners and moon lattice should be extracted. Dry shrubs/lizards plus palms/flowers near water; shared cliff/water families. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated cliff-embedded wall matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
